title: Statistics drilldowns and playback reliability
summary: Open matching History plays directly from Statistics, with the selected period and filters preserved. This release also improves playback tracking, notification setup, signed-in permissions and Docker maintenance.
highlights: Select a title, user, client, playback type or Total Plays in Statistics to open matching History rows with the same period, totals and CSV filters.
Return to the same Statistics position with the browser Back button on desktop, and filter History by exact client or playback method.
Keep Now Playing and library summaries useful when Jellyfin metadata or background work is temporarily unavailable.
Give owners and administrators control of shared settings. Regular users manage their own browser notification devices, while guests remain read-only.
Re-enroll older browser notifications after signing in so Jellydash can associate the device with the correct account.
Run the Docker image on PHP 8.3.33 with an application health check and refreshed amd64 and arm64 builds.
